approved_rules: Three-seed family forecasts are averaged row by row, horizon by horizon and quantile by quantile before the common monotone rearrangement and corrected eligible-day score; no best seed is selected.
Controls remain diagnostics and cannot become selection candidates.
Core conventional and core JEPA development choices remain distinct from the exploratory post-hoc LightGBM, forward-EMA and Chronos-2 operational choice.
Incomplete or partially fitted families cannot enter ranking, and any operational default must be servable by the offline application.
Paired validation summaries use fixed 48-hour source-date blocks, 2,000 draws and seed 20260926 and remain descriptive.
Calibration may only widen frozen 90 percent interval endpoints and cannot alter model selection.
exposure_accounting: The ADR truthfully records that core, hybrid and LightGBM validation outcomes were already available when the exact rule was frozen.
The forward-EMA and Chronos-2 outcomes had not been opened when the rule was committed.
Both core and exploratory choices are post-hoc development selections and carry no confirmatory claim.
Selecting a learned hybrid cannot override its matched random-feature control failure or establish incremental JEPA value.
conditions: A separate reviewed implementation must bind all completed prediction, model and checkpoint hashes and recompute the ranking before numerical calibration access.
Report every completed family, individual seed, ensemble, coverage and paired daily result, including negative JEPA controls.
Do not use this review to authorize calibration numeric access, retrospective TEST numeric access or a SOTA claim.
